visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Five young women stand in a row in a modern, brightly lit living room. The first woman on the left wears a tan top and green skirt; the second wears a white cutout top and black skirt; the third wears a pink dress; the fourth wears a white ruffled dress; the fifth wears a white top with green overalls and a black mask. Large pink and purple text appears at the top. They all begin to laugh uncontrollably while shaking their bodies up and down. (2) The scene transitions to the second type of laughter. The women lean forward or hold their chests while laughing silently. They use their hands to slap their own thighs, bellies, or the air with exaggerated movements. The background shows a television and a white marble-top table. (3) The third phase shows them performing a stylized, dramatic laugh. They throw their heads back and place their hands on their waists or chests, mimicking a traditional theatrical style of laughter. (4) In the final phase, the laughter becomes chaotic as they start physically pushing and leaning on each other. The woman in the pink dress is pushed and falls to the floor behind a cardboard box that suddenly appears. They continue to laugh hysterically while gesturing wildly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track begins with high-pitched, shrill female laughter. Multiple voices overlap in a chaotic, high-arousal display of mirth. There is no background music. (2) A hard cut leads to rhythmic, percussive slapping sounds against skin and fabric. The laughter is replaced by heavy breathing and gasping vocalizations, suggesting a 'silent' but intense laugh. (3) Another hard cut introduces a deep, rhythmic, and projected series of 'Ha Ha Ha' vocalizations. The voices are synchronized in a dramatic, theatrical cadence with high spectral brightness. (4) The final segment features a surge in vocal volume with screams and high-pitched cackling. Distinct shuffling sounds and fabric rustling lead to a loud, dull thud and the crinkling sound of a cardboard box as someone impacts the floor. The audio ends with a high-intensity mixture of shrieks and laughter.
